messages.subject: Inserting into HBase table from a for loop
parts:
Hi,

This is regarding the call to hb.insert function from with in a loop.
I am not being able to correlate what I am getting with my expectation. Any help in this regard is highly appreciated.
Thanks a lot.
Below goes the commands and their respective output.


> hb.new.table("simpleTable", "simple");
[1] TRUE

Created a new table with only column family.

> hb.insert("simpleTable",list( list(1,c("simple:SomeValue1", "simple:SomeValue2"), list("abcd1", "pqr1"))))
[1] TRUE

Inserted first row.

> hb.insert("simpleTable",list( list(2,c("simple:SomeValue1", "simple:SomeValue2"), list("abcd2", "pqr2"))))
[1] TRUE

Inserted second row.

> rows<-hb.scan("simpleTable",start=1,colspec=c("simple"))

Read the rows from the table

> readval <- rows$get()

> readval
[[1]]
[[1]][[1]]
[1] 1

[[1]][[2]]
[1] "simple:SomeValue1" "simple:SomeValue2"

[[1]][[3]]

[1] "pqr1"



[[2]]

[[2]][[3]]
[[2]][[3]][[1]]
[1] "abcd2"

[[2]][[3]][[2]]
[1] "pqr2"


Printing the rows read from the Hbase table.

> length(readval)
[1] 2

Printing no of rows.

Till this point everything simply went correct. Now I am going to insert rows from a for loop and printing the output of hb.insert() function which should be TRUE or FALSE.

> for ( i in 3:10 ) {
+     retVal = hb.insert("simpleTable",list( list(i,c("simple:SomeValue1", "sim
ple:SomeValue2"), list(paste("abcd", i), paste("pqr", i)))))
+ print(retVal);
+ }
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE
[1] TRUE


> rows<-hb.scan("simpleTable",start=1,colspec=c("simple"))
> readval <- rows$get()

Again reading from the HBase table.

> readval
[[1]]
[[1]][[1]]
[1] 1

[[1]][[2]]
[1] "simple:SomeValue1" "simple:SomeValue2"

[[1]][[3]]
[[1]][[3]][[1]]
[1] "abcd1"

[[1]][[3]][[2]]
[1] "pqr1"



[[2]]
[[2]][[1]]
[1] 2

[[2]][[2]]
[1] "simple:SomeValue1" "simple:SomeValue2"

[[2]][[3]]
[[2]][[3]][[1]]
[1] "abcd2"

[[2]][[3]][[2]]
[1] "pqr2"


> length(readval)
[1] 2

Also read the total no of records.

Here I am into a confusion why I am still getting the old rows only?
What happened to the inserts fired from within the for loop?

I think I am missing some simple things, but really could not figure it out. Can you please help?

Thanks and regards,
Souvik.

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#266] Inserting into HBase table from a for loop
parts:
Hi Souvik,

There is a bug in the hb,insert function.   It wants to see a "numeric" instead of "integer" for the row.  So change the following in your loop marked in bold:

retVal = hb.insert("simpleTable",list( list(as.numeric(i),c("simple:SomeValue1", "simple:SomeValue2"), list(paste("abcd", i), paste("pqr", i)))))

David

Thanks and regards,
Souvik.
